$comment: The models a generated surface may be built with, offered in the Weave dock and on the Weave page. Keys, never model ids: the browser sends `context.model` as one of these keys, ee/server/src/weave_surface.rs refuses anything not listed (its GENERATION_MODELS is asserted equal to this file), and the generator maps the key to a real model id and its settings. To add a model: add it to the generator's MODEL_CHOICES (examples/dynamic_ui/dashboard/models.py) and to GENERATION_MODELS, list it here, and copy this file into the Weave checkout — `just weave-image` refuses to build while the bundled copy differs.
